svg.title: PB-GR-001 grip and butt-cap assembly
svg.text: Woven carbon/epoxy plate 4 thk, cut to profile DXF
PA-CF, 3D printed – sheet 3 of PB-EL-001 / PB-HY-001
ISO 7380-1 M4 × 12 button head, A2 stainless
GRIP: 35.5 × 21.5 R3.75 OVER THE WRAP = CIRCUMFERENCE 107.6 (4¼ in). WRAP LENGTH 109.
HANDLE 130 INCL. BUTT CAP. BODY 30 × 16 (CF 4 / CORE 8 / CF 4).
SLEEVE (2): BOND TO THE HANDLE WITH EPOXY, 0.2 GAP PER SIDE FOR THE ADHESIVE.
WRAP (3): REPLACEABLE PU GRIP, SPIRAL FROM THE CAP SKIRT UP TO UNDER THE COLLAR.
COLLAR (4): SLIDE OVER THE WRAP END, BOND TO THE SLEEVE; TOP AT y = 129.
INSERT (7): HEAT-SET AT ≈250 °C, FLUSH WITH THE CORE BUTT FACE (y = 4), SQUARE WITHIN 1°.
SCREW (6): LOW-STRENGTH THREADLOCKER; TIGHTEN UNTIL THE CAP SEATS, MAX 0.8 N·m.
BUTT CAP (5): BASE 4 + SKIRT 6 OVER THE SLEEVE; THE BASE COUNTS IN THE 390 OVERALL LENGTH.
SAME HANDLE ON PB-EL-001 AND PB-HY-001. ALL DIMENSIONS IN mm.
